verification_method: Direct git ls-remote against the official repositories plus review of the repository README and linked paper metadata; no dependency was installed and no external code was executed.

verified_claims: LowMemConv processes extreme-length byte sequences in chunks with fixed-memory pooling.
Global Channel Gating is intended to capture interactions across distant regions of the input.
The upstream repository labels itself research-quality and documents a faulty non-negative training option, so Axon must not copy it without project-native tests and review.
The dataset contains 3.2 million files across six formats.
The benchmark uses 52 training weeks followed by 12 test weeks rather than a random split.
Feature version 3 includes PE data directories, Authenticode, parser warnings, byte statistics, and string statistics.
A separate evasive challenge set is provided.
Random malware splits can induce temporal and spatial evaluation bias.
The reference implementation provides time-aware splits and AUT-style time-robustness evaluation.
Nebula models tokenized dynamic behavior traces rather than using timeout as a benign rule.
The repository exposes Speakeasy trace extraction, pretrained objects, and per-sample entry-point aggregation.
Axon's previous timeout downgrade failure does not invalidate a future behavior-sequence expert, but trace coverage and failure semantics must be rebuilt.

selection_implications.selected_now: MalConv2-style whole-file byte expert behind strict group-aware OOF and a residual fusion gate.
selection_implications.parallel_prerequisite: EMBER2024/TESSERACT-style temporal evaluation reset and independent Loop157 annotations.
selection_implications.deferred: Time-causal reputation and Nebula-style dynamic behavior remain higher-cost connected-system experts after the static diversity gate.
selection_implications.not_selected: Another 8192/32768-prefix MHDSRA run, signer-term expansion, probability-only selector, byte n-gram linear micro-blend, or Speakeasy timeout downgrade.
